snippet.title: 『Magical Princess』Introduction Movie【INDIE Live Expo 2025.11.29】
snippet.description:
A raising sim set in a magical kingdom.
Fulfill the wish of raising a cute girl!

Depending on your choices, she can become an honor student, an idol, a warrior… or even a demon lord.

Demo available!
